text: To exercise the intellect the prince should read histories, and study there the actions of illustrious men, to see how they have borne themselves in war, to examine the causes of their victories and defeat, so as to avoid the latter and imitate the former.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XIV, That which concerns a prince on the subject of war
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
